what: Auditable Cinematic Metaphors for High-Risk Research Findings
title: Auditable Cinematic Metaphors for High-Risk Research Findings
text: Auditable cinematic metaphors high-risk research findings. dataBiosphere converts high-risk findings (health, finance, regulation) auditable cinematic video interactive simulation. enforces three non-negotiable rules: Literal core + metaphorical shell — metaphor encodes qualities number (large/small, certain/uncertain), never replaces . Freeze-frame test — finding (effect size / CI / n) recoverable single frame, scene manipulation forbidden. Faithfulness constraint — metaphor may imply data support.

title: Truth Overlay Badge and Closing Card — truthOverlay
text: effect_type Character. "HR" "". effect_value Numeric. Point estimate. ci_lower, ci_upper Numeric. 95% confidence interval bounds. n Integer. Sample size. finding_label Character. Short finding label. risk_tier Integer. 1 (high), 2 (medium), 3 (low). contains_mortality Logical. TRUE finding involves death, illness, trauma.

title: dataBiosphere 0.1.0
text: First public release. metaphorMatrix(signal_id, data_type): deterministic 12-signal x 3-family (fluvial, arboreal, celestial) matrix faithfulness-forbidden implications. truthOverlay(...): -frame badge closing card keep literal finding (effect size, 95% CI, n) recoverable every frame. Severity Threshold enforced: mortality / illness / trauma findings Tier 3 (game).
